title: Acceptance submission in-flight guard runs lifecycle/card refresh while unwinding from a panic
outcome: Dropping AcceptanceEvaluationSubmissionInFlight during a panic unwind still removes its map entry but doesn't run work that commits, persists or publishes, so a second panic can't abort the process.
acceptance: When the thread is unwinding from a panic, AcceptanceEvaluationSubmissionInFlight::drop removes its entry without running refresh_delegation_for_child_session or refresh_acceptance_evaluation_card, shown by a behavioural test
A child completion observed during a normal submission is still settled when the guard releases, shown by the existing behaviour tests
